question:
Letters are coded as numbers/symbols as per the table given below and the conditions which follow. Refer to the codes and conditions and then select the correct code for SQUARE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ca3ae6b4bd5f030554a7520065dc603e0d0ca216366716a9b8dc88fc93174dc.png] 

**Conditions:**

(i) If there is more than 1 vowel in the word, the vowels will be coded as 4.

(ii) If a word has consonants at both ends, both the consonants will be coded as 2.
solution:
Given word: SQUARE

In the given word 1st condition will be applied which says, 'If there is more than 1 vowel in the word, the vowels will be coded as 4.'

Now the code for the word SQUARE becomes:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ba387421ade9e055b64e037d1454e0241d63d17d1e4476c53511963fe1b4c06.png] 

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1).**
